Subject: Post-session recap — Fintecha POC (July 12) + action items

Theo / team — great session today. Short recap and owners (high priority first):

What we ran:
- Prompt walkthrough: reviewed 42 prompt variants, flagged 6 that need templating and safety hardening.
- Routing exercise: exercised primary -> degraded -> canary fallback; policy rules behaved as expected in 95% of synthetic flows.
- Load test: 10 min ramp, 10 min sustain at ~220 rps with p95 latency ~320ms (quantized model path).

Decisions / asks from today:
- For the 6 flagged prompts we’ll propose templated alternatives and run A/B comparisons (owner: Karthik, due: 2025-07-17)
- Implement the canary fallback as a default for priority lanes and enable tracing (owner: Marissa, due: 2025-07-20)
- Fintecha to confirm whether calls must go through VPC (Theo) — if yes, we’ll schedule a private endpoint setup (owner: Grace for infra coordination, due: 2025-07-22)
- Cost readout: estimated incremental cost for sustained production throughput will be shared next week (owner: Grace, due: 2025-07-19)

Artifacts attached / links:
- session-recording-20250712.mp4 (link in Drive)
- poc-action-items-20250712.md (attached)
- Shared workspace: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxyzFintecha/POC-Workspace
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4981

Next steps:
- Karthik will post the templated prompt proposals into the drive by Friday (17th).
- We’ll run a 30-min follow-up to validate the templated prompts and the canary fallback (proposed window: July 23, 10:30–11:00 AM PT). Theo — please confirm availability for July 23.

If anything is missing from my notes, flag here and I’ll update the action doc. Thanks again to the Fintecha team for a collaborative session.
